safi-cedvel:9-9.t:
* I'rab:
(اقتلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (يوسف) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (أو) a conjunction; (اطرحوا) like اقتلوا, and (الهاء) an object pronoun; (أرضا) accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "in a land" [Note: al-Zamakhsharī makes it an adverb (ẓarf), like the vague adverbs; Ibn ʿAṭiyya rejected that, and Abū Ḥayyān followed him in this.. But if the verb (اطرحوه) is made to carry the meaning of "set him down", then (أرضا) is a second direct object.], (يخل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the command; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يخل); (وجه) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (أبيكم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (كم) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (تكونوا) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يخل), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the subject (ism) of تكون; (من بعد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to صالحين, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (قوما) the predicate (khabar) of the incomplete verb, accusative; (صالحين) naʿt (adjective) of (قوما), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «اقتلوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اطرحوه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause اقتلوا..
The clause «يخل لكم وجه ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ, i.e. "if you cast him away, (your father's face) will be free ..."
The clause «تكونوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يخل لكم وجه..

* Morphology:
(يخل): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive; its original form is يخلو, its pattern يفع.

* Rhetoric:
Kināya (metonymy): in the words of Allah the Exalted «يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ» there is an allusive (talwīḥiyya) metonymy for the purity of love. What is meant is that his love for them would be safe from anyone sharing it with them and contending with them over it.

safi-cedvel:10-10.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb; (قائل) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (من) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective (naʿt) of قائل; (لا) prohibitive, making jussive; (تقتلوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of the jussive being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil; (يوسف) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunctive; (ألقوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) an object pronoun; (في غيابه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ألقوه); (الجبّ) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (يلتقطه) an imperfect verb, jussive, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (بعض) fāʿil, nominative; (السيّارة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (كنتم) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (نا) is the subject (ism) of kāna [Translator's note: so in the source; in كنتم the subject is the pronoun تم, not نا.]; (فاعلين) the predicate (khabar) of كنتم, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the bāʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; evidently a misprint for "the yāʾ".].
The clause «قال قائل ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لا تقتلوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech).
The clause «ألقوه ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «يلتقطه بعض ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ, i.e.: «إنّ تلقوه يلتقطه بعض السيّارة» [Translator's note: so in the source, with إنّ; the intended particle is the conditional إن.].
The clause «كنتم فاعلين» has no grammatical position: resumptive.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e.: "if you are going to do it, then do this much of separating (him from his father)."

* Morphology:
(قائل): active participle of the triliteral قال, its pattern فاعل; its middle radical (ʿayn) was changed into a hamza because it came after the alif of فاعل, and this change is regular in the active participle of the hollow verb.
(ألقوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion; its original form is ألقيوا — with kasra on the qāf and ḍamma on the yāʾ — the ḍamma was felt heavy on the yāʾ, so it was made quiescent and the vowel was transferred to the qāf — this is iʿlāl by quiescence — then the yāʾ was deleted because it met, being quiescent, with the wāw of the plural — iʿlāl by deletion — (غيابة): a name for a ledge or niche in the well near the water, which hides whatever is in it from the eyes.. or it is the bottom of the well; its pattern is فعالة with fatḥa on the fāʾ.
(الجبّ): a name for the well, so called because it is cut into the ground; its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
(السيّارة): plural of السيّار, one of the intensive forms; its pattern is فعّال.
(فاعلين): plural of فاعل, active participle of the triliteral; its pattern is its own form.

safi-cedvel:11-12.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent); (يا) a vocative particle; (أبانا) the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the alif.. and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اللام) a preposition and (الكاف) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of ما; (لا) negating; (تأمنّا) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the nūn on account of the assimilation (idghām).. and (نا) an object pronoun, the fāʿil being "you"; (على يوسف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تأمنّا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) a pronoun in the position of the subject (ism) of inna; (له) like لك, attached to (ناصحون), which is the khabar of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, and (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يا أبانا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech).
The clause «ما لك ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the vocative.
The clause «لا تأمنّا» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the second-person pronoun.
The clause «إنّا له لناصحون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of (يوسف) or of the object pronoun in (تأمنّا).
(أرسله) an imperative verb of supplication, the fāʿil being "you", and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (مع) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to (أرسله), and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (غدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (أرسله); (يرتع) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the command, the fāʿil being "he"; (يلعب) jussive, conjoined to (يرتع) by the wāw; (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl; (إنّا له لحافظون) like إنّا له لناصحون.
The clause «أرسله ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The clause «يرتع..» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «يلعب..» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause يرتع.
The clause «إنّا له لحافظون» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the first-person pronoun in (معنا), or of the third-person pronoun in (أرسله).

safi-cedvel:13-13.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "he"; (إنّي) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and the yāʾ is a pronoun in the position of accusative as the subject (ism) of inna; (اللام) for emphasis; (يحزن) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya) and (الياء) an object pronoun; (أن) a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) particle; (تذهبوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn..
and the wāw is the fāʿil; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تذهبوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تذهبوا..) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of يحزن.
(الواو) conjunctive; (أخاف) an imperfect verb, nominative, the fāʿil being "I"; (أن) like the first; (يأكله) an imperfect verb, accusative.. and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذئب) fāʿil, nominative.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأكله..) is in the position of accusative as a direct object, its governor being أخاف.
(الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial); (أنتم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (عنه) like به, attached to (غافلون), which is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «إنّي ليحزنني ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech).
The clause «يحزنني ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «أخاف ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl clause.
The clause «يأكله», and likewise «تذهبوا ...», has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أنتم عنه غافلون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(الذئب): a primitive (jāmid) noun for the well-known predatory animal; its pattern is فعل with kasra then sukūn.

* Benefits:
- The lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ):
1- It conveys emphasis of the content of the sentence; for this reason, in the chapter of inna, they shifted it away from the head of the sentence, disliking to begin speech with two emphasizers, since (إنّ) likewise conveys emphasis. It also conveys restricting the imperfect to the present, i.e. its indicating the present time. An example of that is the words of Allah the Exalted in this verse إِنِّي لَيَحْزُنُنِي أَنْ تَذْهَبُوا بِهِ.
2- By agreement it enters in two places:
1- The mubtadaʾ: as in the words of Allah the Exalted لَأَنْتُمْ أَشَدُّ رَهْبَةً.
2- After inna (and it is called the shifted lām, al-muzaḥlaqa) because it was shifted from the mubtadaʾ to the khabar. After inna it enters upon three things:
a- The noun: as in the words of Allah the Exalted إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ الدُّعاءِ b- And the imperfect: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ.
c- And the preposition with its genitive noun, or the adverb, as in the words of Allah the Exalted وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلى خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ

safi-cedvel:14-14.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent); (اللام) paving the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam); (إن) a conditional particle making jussive; (أكل) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الذئب) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial); (نحن عصبة) its i'rab has preceded [Note: in verse (8) of this sūra.], (إنّا.. لخاسرون) like إنّا لناصحون [Note: in verse (11) of this sūra.], (إذا) — with tanwīn — a particle of answer with no governing effect.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «إن أكله الذئب ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech).
The clause «نحن عصبة ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, the link being the wāw.
The clause «إنّا إذا لخاسرون ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to the oath.. and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath.

* Rhetoric:
Majāz (figurative usage): in the words of Allah the Exalted «إنا إذا لخاسرون ...» there is a figurative usage for weakness and incapacity, the relation being causality.

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunctive; (لمّا) an adverb (ẓarf) meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the content of the answer; (ذهبوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent); (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (ذهبوا); (الواو) conjunctive [Note: it may be circumstantial (ḥāliyya), the clause after it being a ḥāl with an implied قد.], (أجمعوا) like ذهبوا; (أن) a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) particle; (يجعلوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the dropping of the nūn.. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (الهاء) an object pronoun; (في غيابة الجبّ) a preposition and its genitive noun and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), attached to (يجعلوه).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجعلوه..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, i.e. «على أن يجعلوه», attached to (أجمعوا) by its being made to carry the sense of عزموا ("they resolved") [Note: the interpreted maṣdar may be in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb أجمعوا, since one says: أجمع الأمر and أزمعه.].
(الواو) resumptive; (أوحينا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn.. and (نا) is the fāʿil; (إليه) like به, attached to (أوحينا); (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (تنبّئنّ) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative (marfūʿ).. and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and (هم) an object pronoun, the fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you); (بأمر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تنبّئنّ), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as a badal (substitute) of أمر — or an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — (الواو) the wāw of ḥāl (circumstantial); (هم) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (لا) negating; (يشعرون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «ذهبوا به ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and the answer of لمّا is omitted, its implied form being "they put him in it" [Note: the answer may be the clause قالوا يا أبانا.. that comes later..].
The clause «أجمعوا ...» is in the position of genitive, conjoined to the clause ذهبوا [Note: it may be a ḥāl with an implied قد.].
The clause «يجعلوه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «أوحينا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: this clause is the answer of لمّا according to the Kufans, with the wāw redundant (zāʾida), and there are many parallels to it in the Qur'an according to their view.. such as the words of Allah the Exalted: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَما وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ وَنادَيْناهُ, i.e. ناديناه.
And His words: حَتَّى إِذا جاؤُها وَفُتِحَتْ أَبْوابُها, i.e. فتحت.. and it is a sound view.].
The clause «تنبّئنّهم ...» has no grammatical position: the answer to an implied oath.. and the oath clause with its answer has no grammatical position: explicative [Note: because أوحينا contains the meaning of speaking without its letters.].
The clause «هم لا يشعرون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the third-person pronoun in (تنبّئنّهم).
The clause «لا يشعرون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (هم).

safi-cedvel:16-16.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (جاؤوا) a past verb with its fāʿil (agent); (أباهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).. and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (عشاء) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (جاؤوا); (يبكون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ).. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جاؤوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يبكون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of جاؤوا.

* Morphology:
(عشاء): a name for the time between maghrib and nightfall (al-ʿatama); it is also said: the beginning of darkness; and it is also said: the end of the day. Its pattern is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, and likewise العشيّ.

safi-cedvel:50-50.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قال الملك) a verb and its fāʿil (agent); (ائتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ائتوني); (الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, attached to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) «قال»; (جاءه) a past verb.. and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (الرسول) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); (قال) like «جاء», and the fāʿil is "he", i.e. Yūsuf; (ارجع) an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is "you"; (إلى ربّك) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ارجع) .. and (الكاف) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunction; (اسأله) an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi.. and the fāʿil is "you"; (ما) an interrogative noun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (بال) khabar (predicate), nominative; (النسوة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (اللاتي) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of «النسوة»; (قطّعن) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (النون) is the fāʿil; (أيديهنّ) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb).. and (هنّ) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb; (ربّي) the noun of inna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ..
and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (بكيد) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «عليم», and (هنّ) like the first; (عليم) the khabar of inna, nominative.
The clause «قال الملك ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ائتوني به ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «لمّا جاءه ... قال» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «قال الملك».
The clause «جاءه ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ارجع ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «اسأله ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the second maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «ما بال ...» has no grammatical position, being an explication (tafsīr) of the asking «[Note: Because «سأل» has the meaning of saying without its letters.. or it is an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).. or it is the mafʿūl bihi of the verb of asking, suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative (ما).]».
The clause «قطّعن ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (اللاتي).
The clause «إن ربّي ... عليم» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.

* Morphology:
(بال) a noun meaning state, living and affair, and it may come with the meaning of heart; the alif is converted from a wāw.

safi-cedvel:51-51.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "he", i.e. the king; (ما خطبكنّ) like «ما بال النسوة» «1»; (إذ) an adverb of past time in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خطب»; (راودتنّ) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn.
and (تنّ) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (يوسف) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and it is prevented from nunation because of being a proper name and foreign (ʿujma); (عن نفسه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (راود), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (قلن) like «قطّعن» «2»; (حاش لله) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (31) of this sūra.. and the analysis of (حاش) as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) meaning "declaring Allah exalted" (تنزيها لله) is here preferable to its being a verb.]»; (ما) negative; (علمنا) a past verb and its fāʿil; (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (علمنا) by its being made to contain (taḍmīn) the meaning of «أخذنا» (we found against); (من) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (سوء) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi; (قالت) a past verb.. and (التاء) the tāʾ of the feminine; (امرأة) fāʿil, nominative; (العزيز) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الآن) an adverb of time, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative, attached to (حصحص), which is a past verb; (الحقّ) fāʿil, nominative; (أنا) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject); (راودته عن نفسه) like «راودتنّ يوسف عن نفسه»; (الواو) conjunction; (إنّه) a particle resembling the verb and its noun; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (من الصادقين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of (إنّ), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ما خطبكنّ..» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «راودتنّ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قلن ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «حاش لله» has no grammatical position, being a parenthetical supplication.
The clause «ما علمنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «قالت امرأة ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «حصحص الحقّ» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «أنا راودته ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption — or a justification (taʿlīl) of what preceded.
The clause «راودته ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أنا).
The clause «إنّه لمن الصادقين» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «أنا راودته ...».

* Morphology:
(خطب), a noun meaning affair, and in the verse it carries the sense of a verb, i.e.: what did you do and what did you intend by it.. and for this reason it was valid to attach the adverb (الآن) to it «[Translator's note: so in the source; in the i'rab above it is (إذ) that is attached to «خطب», while (الآن) is attached to «حصحص».]»; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Benefits:
1- «الآن حصحص الحق»:
On the doubled quadriliteral there are two schools:
a- The Kufans hold that the Arabs, when like letters follow one another, as in وسّس, حثّث and لبّب, replace the second of the identical letters with the first letter of the verb, so that it becomes وسوس, حثحث and لبلب, and so on.
b- The Basrans hold that they are two dialects: حصّص is one dialect and حصحص another, and they deny the interchange of letters when their points of articulation are far apart.
2- «الآن» is an adverb denoting the present time. It is indeclinable on the fatḥa. For its being indeclinable on the fatḥa there are two explanations:
a- Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Mubarrad, al-Zamakhsharī and others held that the reason for its being indeclinable on the fatḥa is that it came originally made definite with the alif and lām, so it was likened to the particle and made indeclinable as particles are.
b- As for al-Farrāʾ, he said: its origin is from «آن» or «أنى», which are two past verbs; when we brought the alif and lām onto it, it remained in its indeclinability on the fatḥa. So reflect and choose — may Allah inspire you with what is right.

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb whose implied form is «قلت» (I said), the speaker being the wife of al-ʿAzīz, and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (اللام) the lām of causation (taʿlīl); (يعلم) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after the lām of causation, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he", i.e. Yūsuf «[Note: Or it is the ʿAzīz of Egypt, if the words were said by Yūsuf according to the other view.]», and the interpreted maṣdar (أن يعلم) is in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb.
(أنّ) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of anna; (لم) a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (qalb); (أخنه) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "I"; (بالغيب) a preposition and its genitive noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of «أخنه» or of its object «[Note: Or it is a pure adverb attached to (أخنه).]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّى لم أخنه) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «يعلم».
(الواو) a conjunction; (أنّ) like the first; (الله) the Name of Majesty, the noun of anna, accusative; (لا) negative; (يهدي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is "he"; (كيد) mafʿūl bihi, accusative; (الخائنين) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله لا يهدي..) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the first interpreted maṣdar.
The clause «(قلت) ذلك ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the preceding speech of the wife of al-ʿAzīz «[Note: Or it is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) of an omitted verb according to the other interpretation, i.e. so Yūsuf said: (I requested) that so that he might know ... and the clause of the omitted verb is conjoined to a resumptive clause, i.e.: so Yūsuf was informed and he said....]».
The clause «يعلم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «لم أخنه ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of the (first) anna.
The clause «لا يهدي ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the (second) anna.

* Morphology:
(أخنه), in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion in keeping with the jussive; its origin is أخونه; the wāw was deleted because it met, while quiescent, with the nūn in the jussive state; its pattern is أفله with ḍamma on the fāʾ, and that is to indicate the kind of letter deleted.

* Benefits:
1- The rhetoricians considered it more likely that the words «ذلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ ...» are the saying of Zulaykhā, because that is closer to the situation and more fitting to the context of love, where the lover ransoms the beloved with her own self. Do you not see that when the trial became firmly fixed and reached its extreme, she ransomed him with herself, saying:
(الْآنَ حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ أَنَا راوَدْتُهُ عَنْ نَفْسِهِ وَإِنَّهُ لَمِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ), and she drew near to his heart by her saying (ذلِكَ لِيَعْلَمَ أَنِّي لَمْ أَخُنْهُ بِالْغَيْبِ). This is also confirmed by her saying to the women whose scheming she had heard of: «فَذلِكُنَّ الَّذِي لُمْتُنَّنِي فِيهِ», not caring about how it exposed her.
2- The author of (al-Intiṣāf) said: «The sound position among the schools of Ahl al-Sunna is declaring the prophets free of major and minor sins altogether, and treating the verses that suggest the occurrence of minor sins by interpretation (taʾwīl).
A group of them, together with the Qadariyya, went to permitting minor sins for them, on condition that they are not repellent. And the sound view with us regarding the story of Yūsuf, peace be upon him, is that he is free of falling into anything for which he would be taken to account, and that the pause is at His saying «هَمَّتْ بِهِ», then one begins «وَهَمَّ بِها. لَوْلا أَنْ رَأى بُرْهانَ رَبِّهِ», just as you say: "I would have killed Zayd were it not that I fear Allah," so the inclination (hamm) does not occur, because of the presence of what prevents it, which is the seeing of the proof.
3- Inna and its sisters are particles resembling the verb, because of the presence of the meaning of a verb in each one of them. For emphasis, likening, correction (istidrāk), wishing and hoping are among the meanings of verbs. The particles are: إنّ and أنّ for emphasis, لكنّ for correction, كأنّ for likening, ليت for wishing, لعلّ for hoping.
Their effect: each of these particles enters upon the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar, putting the first in the accusative — it is called its noun — and the second in the nominative — it is called its khabar.

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (ما) a particle of negation; (أبرّئ) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "I"; (نفسي) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh); (النّفس) the noun of inna, accusative; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (أمّارة) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative; (بالسوء) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أمّارة»; (إلّا) a particle of exception; (ما) a relative noun in the position of accusative as the excepted in a connected exception «[Note: Because (ما) in the sense of (من) expresses one soul among the souls, and the (ال) in «النفس» indicates the comprehensiveness of the genus.]»; (رحم) a past verb; (ربّى) fāʿil, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) like the first; (إنّ ربّي) like «إنّ النفس»; (غفور) the khabar of inna, nominative; (رحيم) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «ما أبرّئ ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech) «[Note: In the preceding verse, i.e. the clause: (قلت) ذلك ليعلم أنّي لم أخنه..]».
The clause «إنّ النفس لأمّارة ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «رحم ربّي ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «إنّ ربّي غفور ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāfiyya bayāniyya).

* Morphology:
(أمّارة), an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) from the triliteral verb «أمر», its pattern is فعّالة; the tāʾ is either for the feminine, so its masculine is أمّار, or for intensiveness, like فهّامة.

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قال) a past verb; (الملك) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ائتوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ائتوني); (أستخلصه) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "I"; (لنفسي) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أستخلصه), and (الياء) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, indeclinable, in the position of accusative, attached to (قال); (كلّمه) a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent pronoun whose implied form is "he", i.e. the king «[Note: It is permissible that the fāʿil be Yūsuf, not the king.]».. and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi; (قال) like «كلّم», and the fāʿil is "he", i.e. the king; (إنّك) a particle resembling the verb ... and (الكاف) the noun of inna, in the position of accusative; (اليوم) an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (مكين); (لدينا) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, attached to «مكين» ... and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (مكين) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative; (أمين) a second khabar, nominative.
The clause «قال الملك ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «ائتوني به ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أستخلصه ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «كلّمه ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of the non-jussive condition (لمّا).
The clause «إنّك ... مكين» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.

* Morphology:
(مكين), a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) from مكن يمكن, of the pattern-class of كرم; its pattern is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:55-55.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he", i.e. Yūsuf; (اجعلني) an imperative verb of entreaty, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "you"; (على خزائن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second object «[Note: And if the verb is transitive to one object, then the preposition is attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «اجعلني».]»; (الأرض) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (إنّي حفيظ عليم) like «إنّك مكين أمين».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāfiyya bayāniyya).
The clause «اجعلني ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «إنّي حفيظ ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).

safi-cedvel:56-57.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (الكاف) a preposition of likening «[Note: It is permissible that it be a noun meaning "like", so it is in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar (verbal noun), being its description, and the governing word is the verb «مكّنّا», i.e.: like that establishment in the soul of the king We established Yūsuf in the land; and the meaning is: We established him in the land with an establishment like that establishment]»; (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governing word is «مكّنّا» ...
and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (مكّنّا) a past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn.. and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (ليوسف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مكّنا); (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مكّنا); (يتبوّأ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "he"; (من) a preposition, (ها) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (يتبوّأ); (حيث) an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, attached to (يتبوّأ); (يشاء) like «يتبوّأ», and the fāʿil is "he"; (نصيب) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "We", for majesty; (برحمتنا) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نصيب).. and (نا) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (نشاء) like «نصيب»; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) negative; (نضيع) like «نصيب»; (أجر) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (المحسنين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «مكّنّا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يتبوّأ ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «يوسف».
The clause «يشاء ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «نصيب ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «نشاء ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).
The clause «لا نضيع ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «نصيب».
(الواو) the wāw of the ḥāl; (اللام) the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), giving emphasis; (أجر) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (الآخرة) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (اللام) a preposition; (الّذين) a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to (خير); (آمنوا) a past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma.. and (الواو) the fāʿil; (الواو) conjunction; (كانوا) like «آمنا» «[Translator's note: so in the source, for «آمنوا».]», and it is defective (nāqiṣ) — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (الواو) the noun of kāna, in the position of nominative; (يتّقون) an imperfect verb, nominative ... and (الواو) the fāʿil.
The clause «أجر الآخرة خير ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl.
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «كانوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «آمنوا».
The clause «يتّقون ...» is in the position of accusative as the khabar of kāna.

* Benefits:
1- «حيث»: an adverb of place, indeclinable on the ḍamma, as in «اجلس حيث يجلس أهل الفضل» (sit where the people of merit sit). In the dialect of some Bedouins it is «حوث». It is constantly annexed to a clause, most often a verbal clause, as in the verse we are dealing with, «حيث يشاء», and it is not annexed to a single word; if a single word occurs after it, it is put in the nominative as a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, as in «اجلس حيث خالد» (sit where Khālid is). It may be put in the genitive by «من» or «إلى»: «ارجع من حيث أتيت» (go back to where you came from). And when «ما» is attached to it, it becomes a conditional noun.
2- The biographers (arbāb al-siyar) wove, around this marvellous story, events spun from imagination, and fabricated narrations on which falsehood is evident because of their triviality and feebleness, or their contradiction of reason. So one must scrutinize those narrations whose fabrication is apparent.

safi-cedvel:58-60.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (جاء) a past verb; (إخوة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (يوسف) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (الفاء) conjunction; (دخلوا) like «آمنوا» «[Note: In the preceding verse (57).]»; (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (دخلوا); (الفاء) conjunction; (عرفهم) a past verb.. and (هم) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "he"; (الواو) circumstantial; (هم) a detached pronoun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (له) like «عليه», attached to (منكرون), which is the khabar (predicate), nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw «[Note: Or the lām in (له) is redundant (zāʾida) for strengthening, so the remote position of the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi of the active participle.]».
The clause «جاء إخوة ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «دخلوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «عرفهم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «دخلوا».
The clause «هم له منكرون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «عرفهم» «[Note: It is permissible that it be conjoined to the clause «عرفهم», so it would have no position.]».
(الواو) conjunction; (لمّا) an adverb meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative, attached to (قال); (جهّزهم) like «عرفهم»; (بجهازهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جهّزهم) by its being made to contain (taḍmīn) the meaning of «أكرمهم» ... and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil is "he"; (ائتوني) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (54) of this sūra.]»; (بأخ) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (ائتوا); (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أخ»; (من أبيكم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt of «أخ», the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, for it is one of the five nouns ...
and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (ألا) a particle of gentle request (ʿarḍ) «[Note: - Or the hamza is for interrogation and (لا) is negative.]»; (ترون) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (أنّي) a particle resembling the verb ... and (الياء) the noun of anna; (أوفي) an imperfect verb, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil is "I"; (الكيل) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb); (الواو) conjunction; (أنا) a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ, in the position of nominative; (خير) khabar, nominative; (المنزلين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّي أوفي ...) is in the position of accusative, standing in place of the two objects of «ترون».
The clause «جهزهم ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «ائتوني ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «ألا ترون ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the speech «[Note: Or it has no position, being parenthetical between the two conjoined items in this verse and the following verse.]».
The clause «أوفي ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of anna.
The clause «أنا خير ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause «أوفي».
(الفاء) conjunction; (إن) a jussive conditional particle; (لم) a particle of negation; (تأتوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) «[Note: Because (لم) converts the meaning of the verb from the imperfect to the past; for this reason it is here merely negative, and it is not what puts it in the jussive.]».. and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (النون) is for protection (wiqāya), and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (تأتوا); (الفاء) connective for the apodosis; (لا) the lā of generic negation; (كيل) the noun of lā, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative; (لكم) like the first, attached to the khabar of lā; (عندي) an adverb, accusative, attached to the khabar, the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied on the letter before the yāʾ, and (الياء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunction; (لا) a jussive particle of prohibition «[Note: Or it is negative, and the clause after it is resumptive.. Abū Ḥayyān said: «It is a negation derived (mushtaqq), and its meaning is prohibition; the nūn was deleted while it is nominative, just as it was deleted in (فبم تبشرون); or it is a negation entering into the apodosis, conjoined to the position of (لا كيل), i.e. jussive ...» End.]»; (تقربون) an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of the jussive being the deletion of the nūn ... and (الواو) the fāʿil, and (النون) the particle of protection, and (الياء), deleted for lightening, a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi.
The clause «لم تأتوني ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause «ائتوني».
The clause «لا كيل لكم ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا تقربون ...» is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.

* Morphology:
(منكرون), plural of منكر, an active participle from the quadriliteral (أنكر); its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.
(جهاز), a noun for the necessities of the traveller or others; its pattern is فعال with fatḥa on the fāʾ, and it may rarely take kasra.
(المنزلين), plural of المنزل, an active participle from the quadriliteral (أنزل); its pattern is مفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn.

safi-cedvel:61-61.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma.. and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (السين) a particle of futurity; (نراود) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "we"; (عن) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (نراود); (أباه) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, the sign of the accusative being the alif, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الواو) conjunction; (إن) a particle resembling the verb, for emphasis, and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of inna; (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (فاعلون) the khabar (predicate) of inna, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «سنراود ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «إنا لفاعلون ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the maqūl al-qawl, for emphasis.

safi-cedvel:17-17.t:
* I'rab:
(قالوا يا أبانا) its i'rab has preceded [Note: in verse (11) of this sūra.
(3, 4) in verse (15) of this sūra.], (إنّ) a particle resembling the verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (نا) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the subject (ism) of inna; (ذهبنا) like أوحينا «3», (نستبق) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil (agent) being "we"; (الواو) conjunctive; (تركنا) like أوحينا «4», (يوسف) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (عند) an adverb (ẓarf), accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تركنا); (متاعنا) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr).. and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (الفاء) conjunctive; (أكل) a past verb, and (الهاء) an object pronoun; (الذئب) fāʿil, nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (ما) negating, operating like laysa; (أنت) a detached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as the subject (ism) of ما; (الباء) a redundant (zāʾida) preposition; (مؤمن) genitive in form, accusative in position, the predicate (khabar) of ما; (الواو) parenthetical; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (كنّا) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator — and (نا) a pronoun in the position of nominative as the subject of kāna; (صادقين) the khabar of كنّا, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «يا أبانا ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical.
The clause «إنّا ذهبنا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech) [Note: it may be the answer to the vocative, with no grammatical position, and the vocative clause in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.].
The clause «ذهبنا نستبق ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of inna.
The clause «نستبق ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of ذهبنا.
The clause «تركنا ...» is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause ذهبنا.
The clause «أكله الذئب ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause إنّا ذهبنا.
The clause «ما أنت بمؤمن ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كنّا صادقين ...» has no grammatical position: parenthetical [Note: or circumstantial.. Some grammarians make (لو) mean the conditional إن, i.e. tying its meaning to the future, so it cannot be a ḥāl.].. and the answer of لو is omitted, its implied form being "you would not believe us, because you love Yūsuf."

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (جاؤوا) its i'rab has preceded [Note: in verse (16) of this sūra.], (على قميصه) a preposition and its genitive noun and muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of دم [Note: this is the view of al-ʿUkbarī, and Abū Ḥayyān supported it, even though the ḥāl placed before a noun made genitive by a genuine preposition is disputed among the grammarians; what appears correct is that it may occur so.], (بدم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (جاؤوا); (كذب) naʿt (adjective) of دم, genitive (majrūr), and it is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. ذي كذب ("of falsehood"); (قال) a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "he"; (بل) a particle of digression (iḍrāb); (سوّلت) a past verb.. and (التاء) is for the feminine; (اللام) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (سوّلت); (أنفسكم) fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (أمرا) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (الفاء) conjunctive; (صبر) the khabar (predicate) of a necessarily omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being صبري ("my patience") or أمري ("my affair") or شأني ("my state"); (جميل) naʿt of صبر, nominative; (الواو) conjunctive; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (المستعان) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, nominative; (على) a preposition; (ما) a relative noun [Note: or it is a maṣdar-forming particle.. and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive.. i.e. "against your false description".] indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of genitive, attached to المستعان; (تصفون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «جاؤوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ما أنت بمؤمن [Note: in the previous verse (17).].
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption.
The clause «سوّلت لكم أنفسكم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive, giving the reason for implied speech which is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech), the implied wording being: "you have not spoken the truth in your words; rather, (your souls) have enticed you ..."
The clause «(صبري) صبر جميل ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause سوّلت لكم أنفسكم.
The clause «اللَّه المستعان ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause (صبري) صبر جميل.
The clause «تصفون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (ما), the returning pronoun being omitted, i.e. تصفونه.

* Morphology:
(قميص): a name for what is worn on the skin; it is treated as masculine and feminine; its plurals are أقمصة, قمص with two ḍammas, and قمصان with ḍamma on the qāf; its pattern is فعيل.
(المستعان): passive participle of the six-letter verb استعان; its pattern is مستفعل with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn. In the verb there is iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution: its bare form is عان, originally عون, from العون; the wāw was voweled after a fatḥa and was changed into an alif, and the change remained in the augmented form and the derivative.

* Rhetoric:
Mubālagha (hyperbole): in the words of Allah the Exalted «بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ ...» there is a description by the maṣdar (verbal noun) for hyperbole, as though it were falsehood itself and its very essence, just as one says of a liar: "he is falsehood itself, and lying in person".
Similar to it:
- فهنّ به جود وأنتم به بخل- (So they are, in it, generosity itself, and you, in it, stinginess itself.)

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (جاءت) like سوّلت «1», (سيارة) fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (الفاء) conjunctive; (أرسلوا) like جاؤوا «2» (واردهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb).. and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (الفاء) conjunctive; (أدلى) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif, the fāʿil being "he"; (دلوه) like واردهم; (قال) its i'rab has preceded «3», (يا) a particle of vocative and of wonder; (بشرى) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on ḍamma, in the position of accusative; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذا) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (غلام) khabar (predicate), nominative; (الواو) resumptive; (أسرّوا) like جاؤوا «4», and (الهاء) an object pronoun, and it is on the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. أمره ("his affair") [Note: the pronoun in أسرّوا refers to Yūsuf's brothers, and it is also said to refer to the caravan.], (بضاعة) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of أسرّوا [Note: in its real meaning it is the direct object of an implied governor which is a ḥāl of the fāʿil of أسرّوا, i.e. "making him merchandise".. It was permissible to make it a ḥāl although it is primitive (jāmid) because the expression is to be interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "an acquisition".], (الواو) resumptive; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ, nominative; (عليم) khabar, nominative; (الباء) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming (verbal-noun) particle [Note: or a relative noun, the returning pronoun being omitted, i.e. يعملونه.], (يعملون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما يعملون..) is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, attached to (mutaʿalliq) عليم.
The clause «جاءت سيّارة ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «أرسلوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «أدلى ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أرسلوا.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption connected to speech implied in the course of the story, i.e.: "so Yūsuf clung to the bucket and the water-drawer brought him out, and when he saw him he said: يا بشرى".
The clause «of wonder يا بشرى ...» has no grammatical position: a parenthesis of wonder.
The clause «هذا غلام ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech).
The clause «أسرّوه ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اللَّه عليم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يعملون ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative.

* Morphology:
(وارد): active participle of the triliteral ورد; its pattern is فاعل.
(أدلى): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by substitution; its original form is أدلي, its imperfect يدلي; the yāʾ came voweled after a fatḥa and was changed into an alif; its pattern is أفعل.
(دلو): a primitive (jāmid) noun for that with which water is drawn; it is treated as masculine and, mostly, feminine; its plurals are دلاء with kasra on the dāl, أدل with tanwīn on the lām and the wāw dropped from its end, دليّ with ḍamma or kasra on the dāl and a doubled yāʾ, and دلى with fatḥa on the dāl and an alif maqṣūra after the lām. The pattern of دلو is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(بضاعة): a name for what is prepared for trade; its plural is بضائع, whose pattern is فعائل, and the pattern of بضاعة is فعالة with kasra on the fāʾ.

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunctive; (شروا) like جاؤوا [Note: in verse (18) of this sūra.. If (شروه) is explained as meaning "they sold him", the pronoun refers to Yūsuf's brothers; and if it is explained as meaning "they bought him", the pronoun refers to the caravan, and these took him for a paltry price because they thought he had some defect.], and (الهاء) an object pronoun; (بثمن) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شروا) (بخس) naʿt (adjective) of ثمن, genitive (majrūr); (دراهم) badal (substitute) of ثمن, genitive, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote; (معدودة) naʿt of دراهم, genitive; (الواو) conjunctive [Note: or circumstantial, and the clause كانوا.. is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) with an implied (قد).], (كانوا) an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and the wāw is the subject (ism) of kāna; (في) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to الزاهدين. This attachment is correct — contrary to the view of the Basrans, who forbid the ṣila from preceding the relative — because there is no ambiguity and in order to keep away from strain and forced interpretation. See al-Naḥw al-Wāfī vol. 1 p. 273, footnote [Note: in verse (18) of this sūra.] [Translator's note: so in the source; this footnote reference appears misplaced here.].
The pronoun refers to Yūsuf or to the price, according to a difference in interpretation. (من) الزاهدين) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the khabar (predicate) of كانوا, the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The clause «شروه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause أسرّوه [Note: in the previous verse (19).].
The clause «كانوا فيه من الزاهدين» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause شروه.

* Morphology:
(بخس): an assimilate adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha) in the form of the maṣdar (verbal noun), from بخس يبخس of the فتح class, meaning "he diminished it" or "he found fault with it"; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.
(دراهم): plural of درهم, a primitive (jāmid) foreign noun from the Greek for the struck piece used in transactions (drachma); it is a word applied today to money in general. Its pattern is فعلل with kasra on the fāʾ and fatḥa or kasra on the lām. دراهم may also be the plural of درهام with kasra on the dāl.. and the pattern of دراهم is فعالل.
(الزاهدين): plural of الزاهد, active participle of the triliteral verb زهد; its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
The badal (substitute): in this verse occur the words of Allah the Exalted وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَراهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ: دراهم is a badal of ثمن, genitive like it, with the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote. To complete the benefit we shall explain the most important points relating to this topic:
The badal is a follower (i.e. it follows the substituted-for, al-mubdal minhu, in i'rab), prepared for by mentioning a noun before it (which is the mubdal minhu) that is not intended for its own sake (but is mentioned only as a preparation for the badal). The badal is of four kinds:
1- The corresponding badal, as in the words of Allah the Exalted اهْدِنَا الصِّراطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِراطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ: the second صراط is a badal of الصراط.
2- The badal of part for whole, as in (انقضى النهار ربعه) "a quarter of the day passed": ربعه is a badal of النهار.
3- The badal of inclusion (ishtimāl), as in (يسعك الأمير عفوه) "the emir's pardon embraces you" 4- The badal of error: أعط السائل ثلاثة أربعة "give the beggar three — four". He means four but erred and said three.
So أربعة is a badal of ثلاثة. In the badal of part and of inclusion it is required that they be joined to a pronoun referring to the mubdal minhu, as in the examples above: the hāʾ in (ربعه) refers to النهار and in (عفوه) refers to الأمير.
A verb may likewise be substituted for a verb, as in the words of Allah the Exalted وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْ ذلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثاماً يُضاعَفْ لَهُ الْعَذابُ يَوْمَ الْقِيامَةِ: the verb (يضاعف) is substituted for the verb (يلق).

safi-cedvel:21-21.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قال) a past verb; (الذي) a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); (اشتراه) a past verb, and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the fāʿil being "he", and it is the returning pronoun; (من مصر) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of اشترى, the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa, for it is a diptote; (لامرأته) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (قال), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (أكرمي) an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn..
and (الياء) an attached pronoun in the position of nominative as fāʿil; (مثواه) mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of the accusative being the fatḥa implied (muqaddar) on the alif.. and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (عسى) a complete (tāmm) past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (أن ينفع) an imperfect verb, accusative by the accusative-making أن, and (نا) an object pronoun, the fāʿil being "he".
The interpreted maṣdar (أن ينفعنا..) is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil of عسى.
(أو) a conjunction; (نتّخذ) an imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to ينفع, and (الهاء) a pronoun, first direct object, the fāʿil being "we"; (ولدا) second direct object, accusative; (الواو) resumptive; (الكاف) a preposition of comparison [Note: or a noun meaning "like", in the position of accusative as a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) standing in for the maṣdar, since it is its description, i.e. "like that establishing" ...] (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of genitive, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is مكّنّا; the reference is to the establishing (of Yūsuf) in the heart of the ʿAzīz.. and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (مكّنّا) like أوحينا [Note: in verse (15) of this sūra.], (ليوسف) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مكّنّا), the sign of the genitive being the fatḥa; (في الأرض) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (مكّنّا); (الواو) conjunctive; (اللام) the lām of reason (taʿlīl); (نعلّمه) an imperfect verb, accusative by an understood أن after the lām.. and (الهاء) mafʿūl bihi, the fāʿil being "we", for majesty; (من تأويل) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نعلّمه); (الأحاديث) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن نعلّمه) is in the position of genitive by the lām, conjoined to an omitted interpreted maṣdar attached to (مكّنّا), i.e. "We established Yūsuf so that We might give him dominion and so that We might teach him" [Note: or it is attached to an omitted element coming after it, the wāw before it then being resumptive, i.e. "and so that We might teach him the interpretation of events, that rescue took place".. It is also possible that the wāw is redundant (zāʾida), so that the prepositional phrase is attached to (مكّنا).].
(الواو) resumptive; (اللَّه) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (غالب) khabar (predicate), nominative; (على أمره) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to غالب, and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi; (الواو) conjunctive; (لكنّ) a particle of rectification (istidrāk) and of making accusative — an abrogator (nāsikh) — (أكثر) the subject (ism) of lākinna, accusative; (الناس) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (لا) negating; (يعلمون) an imperfect verb, nominative.. and the wāw is the fāʿil.
The clause «قال الذي اشتراه ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اشتراه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «أكرمي ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech).
The clause «عسى أن ينفعنا ...» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «ينفعنا ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «نتّخذه ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause ينفعنا.
The clause «مكّنّا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «نعلمه ...» has no grammatical position: the ṣila of the understood particle-relative (أن).
The clause «اللَّه غالب ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «لكنّ أكثر الناس ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the last resumptive clause.
The clause «لا يعلمون» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of lākinna.

safi-cedvel:22-22.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (لمّا) an adverb (ẓarf) meaning "when", containing the sense of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آتيناه); (بلغ) a past verb, the fāʿil (agent) being "he"; أشدّه mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (آتيناه) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and (نا) a pronoun, fāʿil, and (الهاء) a pronoun, first direct object; (حكما) second direct object, accusative; (علما) conjoined to the second object by the wāw, accusative; (وكذلك) its i'rab has preceded [Note: in the previous verse (21).], (نجزي) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, the fāʿil being "we", for majesty; (المحسنين) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the yāʾ.
The clause «بلغ ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «آتيناه ...» has no grammatical position: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «نجزي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(أشدّ): plural of شدّة — according to the view of Sībawayh — like نعمة and أنعم.. Others said it is a plural with no singular, or a singular that came in the form of a plural. Its pattern is أفعل with fatḥa on the hamza and ḍamma on the ʿayn. The ʿayn and the lām have been assimilated together.

safi-cedvel:62-63.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (لفتيانه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (قال), and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (اجعلوا) an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn ... and the wāw is the fāʿil; (بضاعتهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) ... and (هم) an attached pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi; (في رحالهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (اجعلوا), and (هم) like the last; (لعل) a particle resembling the verb, for hoping — an abrogator (nāsikh) — and (هم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as the noun of laʿalla; (يعرفون) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and the wāw is the fāʿil, and (ها) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (إذا) an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the content of the apodosis; (انقلبوا) like «قالوا» «[Note: In verse (61) of this sūra.]»; (إلى أهلهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (انقلبوا).. and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (لعلّهم يرجعون) like «لعلّهم يعرفون».
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «اجعلوا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «لعلّهم يعرفونها ...» has no grammatical position, being causal (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يعرفونها ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.
The clause «انقلبوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi ... and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: when they return ... then perhaps they will recognize it.
The clause «لعلّهم يرجعون ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the speech.
The clause «يرجعون ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the second (لعلّ).
(الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (59) of this sūra.
(3, 4) In verse (61) of this sūra.]»; (رجعوا) like «قالوا» «3»; (إلى أبيهم) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (رجعوا), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ, and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi; (قالوا) like the preceding «4»; (يا) a vocative particle; (أبانا) the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the alif ... and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (منع) a past verb in the passive; (من) a preposition and (نا) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (منع); (الكيل) the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative; (الفاء) connective for the apodosis of an implied condition; (أرسل) an imperative verb of entreaty, and the fāʿil is "you"; (معنا) an adverb, accusative, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (أخانا) ... and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (أخانا) mafʿūl bihi, accusative, the sign of the accusative being the alif ... and (نا) like the last; (نكتل) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the answer to the request, and the fāʿil is "we"; (الواو) circumstantial; (إنّا له لحافظون) like «إنّا لفاعلون» «[Note: In verse 63 of this sūra.]» «[Translator's note: so in the source; «إنّا لفاعلون» is in verse 61.]», and the preposition is attached to (حافظون).
The clause «رجعوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «يا أبانا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
The clause «منع منا الكيل ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative «[Note: That is by taking (منع) as truly past ... but if the verb is past in form and future in meaning, then the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. if our brother does not go with us, the measure will be withheld from us the next time ... and it appears that the first meaning is stronger, because of the reading (يكتل) with the yāʾ, a reading of the Seven.]».
The clause «أرسل ...» is in the position of jussive as the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: if you desire the measure, then send.
The clause «نكتل ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ, i.e.: if you send our brother with us, we will obtain measure ...
The clause «إنّا له لحافظون ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil of «نكتل» «[Note: It is permissible that the clause be the answer to an implied oath, because of the presence of the lām in the khabar.. just as it is permissible that it be conjoined to the clause «نكتل» ...]».

* Morphology:
(بضاعة), a noun by which is meant the price paid in exchange for the provisions purchased.
(رحال), plural of رحل, a noun for what is placed on the back of the camel, like the saddle, or the container that carries the necessities; its pattern is فعل with fatḥa then sukūn, and the pattern of رحال is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ; and there is another plural, أرحل, with fatḥa on the hamza and ḍamma on the ḥāʾ.
(نكتل), in it there is an iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion in keeping with the jussive; its origin is نكتال; when two quiescent letters met the alif was deleted; its pattern is نفتل.. The alif is converted from a yāʾ, and the origin of the word is نكتيل — with fatḥa on the tāʾ and kasra on the yāʾ — the kasra was felt heavy on the yāʾ so it was made quiescent — iʿlāl by quiescence — then it was converted to an alif because the letter before it had fatḥa and it was originally voweled, so it became نكتال.

safi-cedvel:64-64.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he", i.e. Yaʿqūb; (هل) an interrogative particle, carrying the meaning of negation; (آمنكم) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) ... and (كم) a pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "I"; (على) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (آمنكم); (إلّا) a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); (الكاف) a preposition of likening; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle; (أمنت) a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn ... and (التاء) the fāʿil, and (كم) mafʿūl bihi; (على أخيه) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أمنتكم), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ ...
and (الهاء) muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (من) a preposition; (قبل) a noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (أمنتكم); (الفاء) resumptive; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (خير) khabar (predicate), nominative; (حافظا) tamyīz (specification), accusative (manṣūb) «[Note: Or an accusative ḥāl (circumstantial).]»; (الواو) conjunction; (هو) a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ; (أرحم) khabar, nominative; (الراحمين) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of the genitive being the yāʾ.
The interpreted maṣdar (ما أمنتكم ...) is in the position of genitive by the kāf, attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: I trust you with him with a trusting like my trusting you with his brother.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «هل آمنكم ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «أمنتكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما).
The clause «الله خير حافظا ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive «[Note: Or it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e. if I send him with you, then Allah is the best guardian.]».
The clause «هو أرحم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «الله خير ...».

* Morphology:
(آمن), the madda is made up of two hamzas, the hamza of the imperfect and the hamza that is the fāʾ of the word; when the second hamza comes quiescent, the two alifs are merged and a madda is placed over it; its pattern is أفعل.
(أرحم), an elative noun (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral «رحم», its pattern is أفعل.
(الراحمين), plural of الراحم, an active participle from the triliteral «رحم», its pattern is فاعل.

* Benefits:
1- «خَيْرٌ حافِظاً»: the grammarians permitted parsing «حافظا» as accusative as a tamyīz or as a ḥāl.
It appears that the sound view is the tamyīz, because if we considered «خير» a ṣifa mushabbaha (resembling adjective) likened to the active participle, the accusative of the noun after it becomes by way of tamyīz «and in its discussion there is detail».
And if we considered «خير» an elative noun, it puts what follows it in the accusative as a tamyīz, so that is one of the ways of parsing the noun after it, as in our saying: «فلان أكرم نفسا وأجمل وجها» (So-and-so is nobler in soul and more beautiful in face), etc.

safi-cedvel:65-65.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction; (لمّا فتحوا ... وجدوا) like «لمّا رجعوا ...
قالوا» «[Note: In verse (63) of this sūra.]»; (متاعهم) mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb), and (هم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (بضاعتهم) like «متاعهم»; (ردّت) a past verb in the passive ... and (التاء) is for the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun whose implied form is "she"; (إلى) a preposition and (هم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ردّت); (قالوا: يا أبانا) its i'rab has passed «[Note: In verse (63) of this sūra.]»; (ما) an interrogative noun «[Note: Abū al-Baqāʾ permitted making it negative, with (نبغي) meaning "we do wrong" or "we transgress" ... and al-Zajjāj made it negative, with the verb meaning "we seek", i.e. nothing remains for us to seek ...]», indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governing word being (نبغي), which is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the fāʿil (agent) is "we"; (ها) a particle of alerting (tanbīh); (ذه) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (بضاعتنا) a badal (substitute), nominative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) — and (نا) muḍāf ilayhi; (ردّت إلينا) like «ردّت إليهم»; (الواو) conjunction; (نمير) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "we"; (أهلنا) like «متاعهم»; (الواو) conjunction; (نحفظ أخانا) like «نمير أهلنا» ... and the sign of the accusative here is the alif; (الواو) conjunction; (نزداد) like «نمير»; (كيل) tamyīz (specification), accusative; (بعير) muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (ذلك) a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ ... and (اللام) is for distance and (الكاف) for address; (كيل) khabar (predicate), nominative; (يسير) a naʿt (adjective) of «كيل», nominative.
The clause «فتحوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «وجدوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition.
The clause «ردّت إليهم ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), with «قد» implied.
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «يا أبانا ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
The clause «ما نبغي ...» has no grammatical position, being the answer to the vocative.
The clause «هذه بضاعتنا ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption «[Note: And Abū Ḥayyān said: it clarifies their saying «ما نبغي», and the clauses after it are conjoined ...]».
The clause «ردّت إلينا ...» is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هذه).
The clause «نمير أهلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «هذه بضاعتنا».
The clause «نحفظ أخانا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «هذه بضاعتنا».
The clause «نزداد ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause «هذه بضاعتنا».
The clause «ذلك كيل ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive within the scope of the speech.

* Morphology:
(بعير), a non-derived (jāmid) noun for the camel that has cut its ninth tooth (al-bāzil), applied to male and female; its plural is بعران — with ḍamma on the bāʾ — and أبعرة, and the plural of the plural is أباعر and أباعير; the patterns are respectively فعيل with fatḥa on the fāʾ, فعلان with ḍamma on it, أفعلة, أفاعل and أفاعيل.

safi-cedvel:66-66.t:
* I'rab:
(قال) a past verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (لن) a particle of negation and futurity; (أرسله) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and (الهاء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the fāʿil is "I"; (مع) an adverb, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object pronoun «[Note: Or attached to the verb «أرسله».]», and (كم) a pronoun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (حتّى) a particle of limit and a preposition; (تؤتون) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied «أن» after «حتّى», the sign of the accusative being the deletion of the nūn ... and (الواو) the fāʿil, and (النون) the nūn of protection (wiqāya), and (الياء), deleted for lightening, mafʿūl bihi; (موثقا) a second object, accusative; (من الله) a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (موثقا) «[Note: I.e. a pledge witnessed over by Allah.]».
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تؤتون) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (أرسله).
(اللام) the lām of the oath, because the covenant is an oath; (تأتنّ) an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of the nominative being the retention of the nūn, and it was deleted because of the succession of like letters, and (الواو), deleted because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil, and (النّون) with shadda is the nūn of emphasis, and (النّون) without shadda is for protection, and (الياء) a pronoun, mafʿūl bihi; (الباء) a preposition and (الهاء) a pronoun in the position of genitive, attached to (تأتنّ); (إلّا) a particle of exception; (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative particle; (يحاط) an imperfect verb in the passive, accusative; (الباء) a preposition and (كم) a pronoun in the position of genitive, as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يحاط ...) is in the position of accusative as the excepted, with a muḍāf omitted, i.e. you will surely bring him to me in every state except the state of being surrounded «[Note: Or: you will not refrain from bringing him for any cause except the cause of your being surrounded.]».
(الفاء) conjunction; (لمّا أتوه ... قال) like «لمّا رجعوا ... قالوا»; (موثقهم) mafʿūl bihi, accusative ... and (هم) muḍāf ilayhi, and the fāʿil of «قال» is "he", i.e. Yaʿqūb; (الله) the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative; (على) a preposition; (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle «[Note: Or a relative noun in the position of genitive ... and the returning pronoun is omitted, and the clause after it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.]»; (نقول) an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is "we"; (وكيل) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, nominative.
The clause «قال ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لن أرسله ...» is in the position of accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of speech).
